描述_EN: (dakinis are female personifications of enlightenment who appear to inspire, encourage and initiate the human practitioner.) she dances at the centre of the picture and is surrounded by four other emanations of herself. emperors of the ming dynasty patronised the temple in the 15th century. its style links it to a group of paintings that buddhist patrons created for the ‘temple of great and mighty benevolence which protects the dynasty’, located in the north-west of beijing. it was a renowned centre of tibetan buddhist teaching in china. she holds a chopper of drigu in her right hand. in her left she holds a skull cup or kapala and a ritual staff or khatvanga. this scroll painting or tangka depicts a mandala of simhavaktra, the ‘lion faced’ dakini. this tangka has been painted in the nepalese-tibetan style. this had been established in china for buddhist art production more than 150 years earlier.
描述_ZN: （Dakinis是女性启蒙者的化身，她们出现在人类修行者的面前，启发、鼓励和启动人类修行者。）她在画面中央跳舞，被她的其他四个发心所包围。 15世纪时，明朝的皇帝们赞助了这座寺庙。 其风格与佛教徒为位于北京西北部的 "保护王朝的大雄宝殿 "创作的一组绘画有关。 它是中国著名的西藏佛教教学中心。 她的右手拿着一把菜刀。 她的左手拿着一个头骨杯或卡帕拉和一个仪式杖或卡特凡加。 这幅卷轴画或唐卡描绘了simhavaktra的曼陀罗，"狮面 "达基尼。 这幅唐卡是以尼泊尔-提贝坦风格绘制的。 这种风格早在150多年前就在中国的佛教艺术生产中被确立。
